thread:
amelia: hey folks :wave: onboarding question — my benefits enrollment confirmation shows tier = "Employee + Child" but i enrolled for spouse + child during the call. i also uploaded the marriage cert and spouse SSN during onboarding. on top of that, my relocation flight reimbursement was approved but i haven't seen the payment in my bank yet (receipt submitted as amelia_flight_receipt.pdf). lastly, i picked HSA and pre-tax commuter but payroll preview shows HSA: none and commuter deduction $0. worried about first paycheck and holiday on 04/19 (starting 04/15) — who do i poke to make sure deductions and reimbursements land?

people-ops-bot: payroll-run:2026-04-14 18:00 UTC — payroll export created. cutoff for changes: 2026-04-14 14:00 UTC. submissions after cutoff will apply to next run.

chris (people-ops): welcome amelia! :tada: thanks for the details. short checklist will help us triage: 1) DM me the last 4 of your SSN and the exact upload filename for the marriage cert, 2) confirm the expense request ID for the flight or the Expensify link, 3) paste a screenshot of your benefits confirmation page (or upload to https://benefits.redwood.com/upload with filename amelia_benefits.png). i'll loop payroll/benefits/finance here.

amelia: DMed last4 (3321). expense id EX-57822 and receipt uploaded. benefits screenshot uploaded as amelia_benefits.png.

diego (payroll): thanks amelia. quick notes: if the broker sent the dependent feed as Employee+Child we'll need benefits to resend correct tier to payroll. if we don't get the corrected feed before cutoff we can apply the change next run and do a retro deduction adjustment if needed. on HSA and commuter: payroll only applies deductions that appear in the broker/payroll feed. ana — can you confirm whether spouse was validated and whether HSA/comuter elections were included in the latest feed?

ana (benefits): hi all  hi amelia  i see your uploads but broker validation flagged a missing spouse SSN field in the XML. i've reattached the document to the submission and requested a broker re-feed. opened BEN-4907, ETA 48 hrs. regarding HSA: your HSA election was captured in the portal but broker's feed didn't include it because plan elections were flagged pending (carrier rule). i'm asking broker to prioritize HSA and commuter elections in the next feed.

finance (expenses): hi amelia  i pulled EX-57822 — manager approved on 2026-04-12 and AP queued payment on 2026-04-13. typically payments hit 1 payroll cycle after approval, but we can do a manual ACH if you need it faster. if you want immediate transfer, reply here and i'll route to treasury for an ad-hoc ACH (they need bank routing/account and a confirmation that manager approved in Expensify).

amelia: i'd appreciate the ACH if possible — first paycheck timing is tight. manager confirmed approval in Expensify. DMing bank last4 and routing masked.

people-ops-bot: BEN-4907 updated: broker acknowledged issue with missing spouse SSN field. ETA 2026-04-16 11:00 UTC for re-feed.

diego (payroll): got the bank info for ACH. finance — thanks for offering; please proceed with ad-hoc ACH for EX-57822 and CC me so payroll can note cashflow. on the payroll side i've queued a correction task: if broker re-feeds spouse+child before 2026-04-14 14:00 UTC we'll include it in this run; otherwise we'll apply next run and process retro deductions as needed.

ana (benefits): broker re-feed scheduled and prioritized. plan elections (HSA + commuter) requested to be included. if broker can backdate elections to 04/15 we can request payroll retro-adjustment; if not, deductions will start when carrier accepts.

amelia: thanks. one more question — for the company holiday on 04/19, am i eligible even though i start 04/15 and benefits may show effective 05/01? i need to plan childcare.

chris (people-ops): good Q. holiday eligibility is based on our payroll active flag (not carrier effective date). as long as your employee record shows active on 04/19 you'll get holiday pay. benefits carrier rules only affect medical deduction timing and claim coverage. we'll confirm employment active flag in payroll now.

people-ops-bot: payroll-run:2026-04-13 20:00 UTC — next export scheduled.

diego (payroll): confirmed we can mark employment active for 04/19 so holiday pay will be honored. we'll still need the broker re-feed to adjust deductions. if HSA/commuter don't land before the run i'll add a retro request so your elective deductions start effective 04/15 and we correct net pay.

finance (expenses): ACH initiated for EX-57822. ETA to bank: 24-48 hrs. please confirm when funds land and we'll close the expense.

amelia: received — thank you so much everyone. i see benefits portal updated to spouse+child now. will check paystub after payroll posts and report back if HSA/commuter still missing. really appreciate the fast triage :heart:
